variants.name: Storybook atelier
variants.direction: Direction A — STORYBOOK ATELIER. Draw charming but refined bespoke upright bookish lettering, a contemporary artisan storybook masthead. Soft wedge serifs, gently swollen rounded bowls, a beautifully distinctive uppercase P and open C, generous lowercase counters, slightly flared hand-cut terminals. Introduce one subtle clever f–t shared crossbar that feels like a bookbinding thread; a small softly tapered finishing stroke, not an illustration. Mostly deep rose #B8405F with restrained warm-black details only if needed. The lettering has enough body to stand next to the colorful illustrated icon. Editorial polish and a unique recognizable silhouette. Do not use a thin fashion serif or a standard Times-like font.

variants.name: Folded plan
variants.direction: Direction B — FOLDED PLAN. A bespoke contemporary rounded geometric wordmark built with the visual logic of folded sheets of paper. Sturdy, beautifully proportioned humanist sans lettering with clever small angled fold cuts inside the P and C and in the f/t join; the cuts are part of the letterforms, not extra icons. Warm, inviting, clearly readable, single-storey a, soft corners with precision-crafted edges. "Plan" warm black #1A1A1A, "Craft" deep rose #B8405F, same substantial optical weight throughout. Custom letter construction and elegant negative space make it feel designed, not typed. Neither generic SaaS nor sci-fi.

variants.name: Makers ribbon
variants.direction: Direction C — MAKERS RIBBON. Draw a distinctive custom connected brush-ribbon wordmark, a confident creative studio signature. Controlled flowing lowercase with a strong uppercase P and C, medium-bold strokes, short ascenders and generous readable counters. Sophisticated f–t ligature and a short sweeping t finish kept within the compact logo footprint. Mild forward movement, carefully controlled baseline. Deep rose #B8405F, with rose #D4547A only as a tiny flat accent integrated into one terminal if needed. Warm and tactile in shape, but absolutely flat clean vector-like execution. No long underline, no flourishes that obscure the letters, no wedding calligraphy, no fragile hairlines, no stock italic type.

variants.name: Craftsman press
variants.direction: Direction D — CRAFTSMAN PRESS. Create a bold, compact, beautifully hand-shaped soft slab-serif wordmark inspired by artisan printmakers and modern Arts and Crafts book lettering. Broad stable P and C, low-contrast strokes, rounded-square counters, sculpted bracketed slab serifs, subtly playful rhythm without tilting individual characters. A distinctive a and f/t negative-space relationship. "Plan" warm black #1A1A1A and "Craft" deep rose #B8405F, unified semibold weight. Craftsmanship is in the actual construction of each glyph, with controlled irregularity and optical sophistication. Warm and memorable, not western saloon, not varsity, not retro distressed, not a default slab font.
